_doc: PLAN.md 4.3, Phase 3.3. How the flight controller turns a stick into thruster throttles. Units: U, seconds, radians. Top speed in a direction is push / (mass x linear_damp).

camera._doc: Follow camera (3.5). The ship's longest side takes ship_screen_share of the screen height at rest; the view zooms out by speed_zoom_out per U/s, down to min_zoom_share of that. It leads the ship by look_ahead_s of its velocity. The player's zoom (pinch, mouse wheel, +/-; owner, 2026-10-26) multiplies all of it, within view_zoom_min..view_zoom_max, zoom_step per key press or wheel notch; it's saved in Settings. The speed zoom-out was deepened the same day (0.025 / 0.6 before) so a fast ship sees further.

pickups._doc: Phase 5.4. A kill's loot (economy.json drops) scatters from the tiles left on the wreck, outward, at up to scatter_u_s plus scatter_per_blast_u per U of the blast (the size of what was left of the ship; owner, 2026-10-26: a big blast throws it wide, a stub drops it close), and drifts to a stop (drift_damp a second). Within magnet_u of the player's hull it flies in at pull_u_s plus the ship's own speed, turning at pull_accel_u_s2, and within collect_u it's in the cargo hold. Uncollected pickups go after life_s, blinking for the last blink_s.
pickups._glint: 8.2 (owner, 2026-10-26: loot was easy to miss): each pickup's halo pulses pulse_hz times a second, and a glint crosses it every glint_every_s.

edge_markers._doc: Owner, 2026-10-26: a mark at the screen's edge points at the carrier when it's off screen. Within dot_within_u of the edge it's a full-size dot (about to come into view); further off an arrow, shrinking from full size to smallest_share at smallest_at_u. An enemy that has been on screen gets a solid dot of fixed size at the edge while it's off screen and within sight_range_u of the player's ship; beyond that it's forgotten until seen again (5.5, owner 2026-10-26). Radar tech (v2) marks the rest.

spawner._doc: Phase 5.5, the Spawner every mode shares (src/flight/spawner.gd). A fight (an encounter) appears just off screen round the player: its ships in groups of up to ships_per_side, each group from its own side, lined up abreast ring_gap_u apart, the nearest edge ring_margin_u beyond the view's corner, at least arena_inside_u inside the arena (a group turns to find room), facing the player. A single test ship (the sandbox's Spawn cards) appears spawn_gap_u ahead of the player instead (owner, 2026-10-26: twice the first 6 U), turned spawn_facing_deg from the player (one without thrusters, a practice target, target_rotation_deg). The carrier appears carrier_beside_u to the player's right, pointing the same way, and flies the route it's given; enemies go for whichever of the player and the carrier is nearer, the carrier's distance counted at carrier_bias, so they make for it (an escort, 12.3).
spawner._fire_grace: PLAN.md 8.7 (from 7.2): an enemy holds its fire until it has been in view (any part within the view round the player) or fire_grace_s has passed since it spawned, so a high level can't kill the player from off screen before anything shows.

sandbox._doc: Flight sandbox extras (4.2): start_target (a practice target from data/enemies) is parked ahead at the start. The Spawn button (owner, 2026-10-26) lists every ship to spawn: practice targets, the roster, the carrier and the player's own ships; where they appear is the spawner's (above), and a roster ship flies itself (5.2). The carrier flies carrier_route round and round, laid out in the player's frame at spawn (x ahead, y to the right). A tap on any ship's tile highlights it, and hits it for test_hit raw damage of test_hit_type (0 since the guns arrived in 4.3). The player's ship comes back respawn_s after it's destroyed. The Guns button steps a Creative ship's guns through gun_levels (4.3); a stocked ship's guns are inventory items at their own levels. A single spawned enemy comes at encounter_level (its guns about 10x that, at the level's damage share, levels.json), and a kill earns XP at the enemy's own level (4.8b) and drops its loot as pickups (5.4, pickups). The Spawn list's encounter_buttons spawn a generated fight at that level off screen round the player (5.5), and hvt_buttons a Kill HVT one led by a boss (5.3).

cinematics._doc: PLAN.md 8.1, WaveTime and Story only (Creative goes straight in; no skip, owner 2026-10-30). Launch: the hangar fades to black in fade_s, space fades in with the ship inside the bay, and it boosts out on its own thrusters for launch_s while the camera eases out from zoom_in times its usual zoom; then the player has it and the first wave comes. A ship destroyed in a run throws out an escape pod at pod_speed_u, accelerating at pod_accel_u_s2, and the results card follows after pod_s. Return to hangar plays the dock screen: the ship (or the pod) glides into the bay over dock_s, the shutter closes in shutter_s, and it fades to the hangar.

damage_numbers._doc: PLAN.md 8.3: floating numbers over every hit on an enemy, in every mode. Hits on one ship within merge_s add up into one number; it rises rise_px and fades over life_s. Its size runs min_px..max_px and its colour white..gold..red as the damage climbs (log scale) to big_hit. At most max_live show at once (the oldest goes). A kill in a run pops its score in gold at pop_px.

focus._doc: Target focus (owner, 2026-10-31): a tap on an enemy, or within pick_px of one on screen, makes it the focus: every gun that can reach it shoots it first, and a reticle marks it. A tap on open space, or the focus dying, clears it. A finger that moves more than tap_px is a drag or a pinch, not a tap.

combat_hud._doc: Phase 4.7. A hit on the player flashes the screen (red for hull, blue for shield only) for flash_s, at up to flash_alpha. Screen shake jolts the view by shake_px_per_damage per point of damage, up to shake_max_px, settling at shake_decay per second. A hull hit of at least vibrate_min_damage buzzes the phone for vibrate_ms. Both obey the Controls settings.

arena._doc: The flight sandbox's bounds (3.5): a square of half_size_u around the start. Inside warn_margin_u of the edge the HUD warns; past the edge a push of push_back U/s^2 per U of depth steers the ship back. Story mode replaces the push with the world map (4.10).

bench._doc: The performance test (PLAN.md 7.5, Creative's Fly panel): section 5.5's worst case flown with the Creative ship, which takes no damage. A station stand-in (cols x rows Large squares round a core, a turret every 4th column and 3rd row with guns taken in turn from guns) sits ahead; `enemies` roster ships at `level` come in round the player, spawns_per_tick at a time, and are replaced as they fall; the projectile pool is topped up to `shots` with zero-damage sprays from the player (shot_speed_u, out to shot_range_u). After warmup_s, every frame is timed for `seconds`. Runs are kept in user://perf_runs.json.
bench._breakdown: breakdown: time each system (AI, flight, guns, frame scripts) as well; false for the lowest-overhead run, when comparing two builds.
